name: Acterra
summary: US environmental charity that takes local environment projects with a US base under its own charity status, for at least two years.

evidence.quote: All fiscally sponsored projects must be aligned with the Acterra mission of bringing people together to create local solutions for a healthy planet
3921 East Bayshore Road, Suite 210 Palo Alto, CA 94303

projects.value: Local environment projects that fit Acterra’s mission

evidence.quote: All fiscally sponsored projects must be aligned with the Acterra mission of bringing people together to create local solutions for a healthy planet

where.value: Projects with a US base of operations

evidence.quote: Projects must have a U.S. base of operations.
Acterra's board of Directors assumes full legal and fiduciary responsibility for all projects
Typically a fee of 10% will be incurred on all revenues.

fees.value: Other fees may apply, by grant source or for non-standard services

evidence.quote: Other fees might apply, depending on the source of the grant support or other non-standard services.
Each project must be prepared to be a project of Acterra for at least 2 years.
Make sure you meet the eligibility requirements listed above.

steps.value: Send the interest form, reviewed within 2 weeks

evidence.quote: Complete & submit the fiscal sponsorship Interest Form. We will review it within 2 weeks.

steps.value: If they OK it, a call about your mission, activities, needs and timeline

evidence.quote: If we OK the submission, we'll set up a call to discuss your mission, program activities, needs, and timeline.
Next, we will invite you to send a formal application. Application is by invitation only.

steps.value: If staff and board approve, the agreements are signed

evidence.quote: If our staff and board of directors approve you, we sign the necessary agreements and start collaborating.

steps.value: Generally 6 to 10 weeks to set up

evidence.quote: Generally, it takes 6-10 weeks to set up a fiscally sponsored project at Acterra.
